meta.name: user-stories
meta.description: Create user stories following the 3 C's (Card, Conversation, Confirmation) and INVEST criteria with descriptions, design links, and acceptance criteria. Use when writing user stories, breaking down features into backlog items, or defining acceptance criteria.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按3C和INVEST标准编写用户故事
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要将功能拆解为用户故事并编写验收条件
copy.tagline_en: Write user stories following 3C and INVEST criteria
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often break down features into user stories and define acceptance criteria

howto.what: Claude 会按照 3C 和 INVEST 标准，帮你把功能拆成用户故事，每个故事包含标题、描述、设计链接和验收条件。
howto.when: 当你需要编写用户故事、将功能拆解为待办项或定义验收条件时触发。

say.text: 帮我为购物车功能写用户故事，设计在 Figma 上。
say.note: Claude 会生成一组用户故事。

say.text: 把“用户登录”功能拆成几个用户故事。
say.note: Claude 会按步骤分析并输出故事。

howto.what_en: Claude will break down features into user stories following the 3 C's and INVEST criteria, each with title, description, design link, and acceptance criteria.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to write user stories, break down features into backlog items, or define acceptance criteria.

say_en.text: Write user stories for the shopping cart feature, design in Figma.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a set of user stories.

say_en.text: Break down the 'user login' feature into user stories.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and output stories step by step.
